comparison_method: HTTP method plus literal spec path and named component schema. Structural JSON equality; per-record hashes sort object keys, keep array order, and use compact UTF-8. Dart and SDK route candidates match literal source paths after normalizing path parameters and fragments. They identify files to inspect and do not establish verb, body, response or protocol coverage. Schema ownership follows transitive references with shared ticket links. Unreferenced schemas are reconciled at closeout.

operations.gap: The response is an array. Baseline casts it to a JSON map.
Baseline getEntries calls an undocumented /entries suffix.
Baseline drops model/segment fields and conflates word and segment granularity.
Baseline drops terminal and segment fields. Fragment is metadata only.
The request needs a messages envelope. Baseline serializes a flat list.
Accept individual or batched message envelopes.
Classification results use named targets containing score maps.
FIM JSON message and SSE delta are objects on the current wire. Baseline casts to string.

supplemental_findings.finding: PR #594 parses string or chunk-list DeltaMessage content and preserves copyWith string compatibility. PR #410 tracks prompt and completion token detail even when the published schema drops completion details. PR #438 covers stalled stream cancellation.

Complete the shared chat, agents and FIM generation contracts. FIM uses structured assistant and delta messages on the current wire. Chat needs typed resource and resource-link chunks, image URL detail, new connector enumeration, logprobs and service tier.

The older Predicted Outputs guide advertises a latency benefit. Pinned OpenAPI and Python mark prediction ignored and planned for removal. Retain the field and document the pinned behavior. Retain safe_prompt which is deprecated in favor of custom guardrails.

ChatCompletionResponse lists data as required without a data property. Both official SDKs and public examples use choices without data. Match observed shape. The agent completion spec omits SSE as a response media type. Both SDKs implement it at the same POST route, which Dart preserves.

Responses is stateless. Add create/stream/count, namespaced functions and caller-supplied history. No follow-up retrieval, background execution, persistent IDs or conversation endpoints. The Mistral contract governs the Dart surface.

Use the public schema and Python for image/audio embeddings and moderation queries and metadata. Released TypeScript still constrains embedding input to text and uses ClassificationRequest for moderation. Preserve base64 embedding payloads if sent and keep numeric callers working.

Add OCR 4.1 confidence granularity and score shapes. Existing Dart base64 constructors must serialize supported image/document URL data rather than the old base64 discriminator. Correct classification message envelopes and preserve arbitrary named scores.
OCR 4.0 retired September 30, 2026. Guide examples use OCR 4.1. Keep custom model strings and document legacy fine-tuning, native reasoning and moderation guidance.

Support new Voxtral speech and transcription fields, both timestamp modes, segment and terminal SSE shapes, voices v2 pagination and sample bytes. Tagged SDK multipart encodings agree on one JSON speaker_references part; Python sets its media type to application/json. Keep existing audio inputs and optional legacy request controls.

GET/POST in HTTP OpenAPI does not enumerate Voxtral realtime WebSocket frames. Use the guides and pinned SDK extras for wss /v1/audio/transcriptions/realtime and /v1/audio/speech/realtime. Use the dedicated client session token route and browser STT subprotocols. TTS browser credentials lack a documented contract.

Voice Agents REST and LiveKit participant transport are documented. Pinned Python and OpenAPI expose session PATCH; tagged TypeScript helper uses the LiveKit mistral.session_update RPC. Cover REST and document both supported interaction paths.

Dedicated SIP/phone number and event subscription provisioning routes lack a pinned public reference. Python-only custom worker registration needs a supplied control-plane base URL. Include documented session transport and event payloads, and track provisioning once Mistral publishes stable paths, auth and schemas.

Conversations needs list-array decoding, /history and /messages, completion_args, tool_call_id, multipart entry/event handling and three SSE entry points. The guide recommends Managed Agents for new projects. Keep available legacy Agents and Conversations routes and document the distinction.
Fine-tuning jobs removed in #287. Keep still-published model operations. Older BatchJobStatus timeout value is a known toolkit baseline error.

Credential routes template consumer scope in the November contract. Support scoped POST create, PATCH update, scoped DELETE and workspace and organization sharing. Legacy callTool still published and deprecated.

Managed Search is hosted public preview, with 15 new endpoints and NDJSON summary generation. Removed legacy /v1/rag/indexes operations map to a distinct earlier registration product. Do not claim a direct migration or remove public Dart types based on absence alone.

Python reflects all 57 workflow operations. TypeScript v3.5.0 predates deployment archive creation. Follow published archive/worker/tag/unhardening and workflow contracts, and keep registration execution labeled deprecated while it remains published.

The spec and Python expose 63 Observability operations; TypeScript is behind six. 24 baseline operations disappear from the spec, but some are in TypeScript or current Mistral cookbook. Cover the current surface and preserve legacy wrappers as deprecated when a sunset is unconfirmed.

Billing endpoints and service accounts require the operation-specific workspace credential convention. Users can use bearer or documented workspace context where supported. Workflow trigger webhooks are separate from Voice Agent events.

Enterprise Preview Admin routes are public in the OpenAPI/reference but absent from both tagged generated SDKs. Follow the Admin authentication guide's dedicated x-api-key header using a separate credential. OpenAPI incorrectly labels AdminApiKey as Authorization Bearer.
Scope analytics, usage, audit log and key operations to the Admin client; redact returned raw secrets. Do not infer endpoints from the Admin Panel announcements.
